name: zhouxing-no-input-blue-fallback
scope: Cobalt blue is only the built-in no-input 2D fallback, not a universal palette. Supplied characters drive the project colors unless explicitly overridden. Backgrounds may vary coherently by page role; authentic screenshots retain original colors.
selection_priority: largest visible chromatic color family of supplied character, excluding background, skin and neutrals
built-in blue fallback for no supplied character or palette

palette_policy.native_colors: dominant hue tonal scale plus neutral white/near-black/gray
palette_policy.avoid: promoting skin, outlines or small accessories into unrelated page colors
